info.title: LinkedIn member sign-in and posting (independent, hand-built)
info.description: Minimal operation set for LinkedIn's self-serve products Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect and Share on LinkedIn, written by Ragentic from LinkedIn's public documentation (see x-ragentic-origins). This is NOT an official LinkedIn definition and is not endorsed by LinkedIn. Organization (company page) posting, reading posts and other Community Management features require LinkedIn product approval and are deliberately not included.

get.summary: Get the signed-in member's OpenID Connect profile
get.description: Returns the OpenID Connect claims of the authenticated member. The `sub` claim is the member ID used to build the person URN `urn:li:person:{sub}` for createPost. Requires the openid and profile scopes; email and email_verified require the email scope.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked access token

post.summary: Create a post as the signed-in member
post.description: Creates a post authored by the authenticated member (Share on LinkedIn, scope w_member_social). `author` must be `urn:li:person:{sub}` where sub comes from getUserInfo. The connector sends the LinkedIn-Version and X-Restli-Protocol-Version headers. On success LinkedIn answers 201 with the new post URN in the x-restli-id response header and an empty body. Posting as an organization requires the Community Management API and is not supported by this definition.

201.description: Post created; the post URN is in the x-restli-id header

x-restli-id.description: URN of the created post, for example urn:li:share:{id} or urn:li:ugcPost:{id}

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked access token

403.description: The token lacks w_member_social or author is not the authenticated member

delete.summary: Delete a post created by the signed-in member
delete.description: Deletes a post by its URN (as returned in x-restli-id by createPost). The URN must be URL-encoded in the path. Deletion is idempotent and answers 204.

parameters.name: postUrn
parameters.description: URL-encoded post URN, for example urn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A6844785523593134080

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked access token

403.description: The post does not belong to the authenticated member

LinkedInOAuth.description: LinkedIn 3-legged OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Self-serve access tokens last 60 days; programmatic refresh tokens are only issued to approved partners, so members reconnect when the token expires.

scopes.openid: Use OpenID Connect to sign in
scopes.w_member_social: Create, modify and delete posts on behalf of the member

sub.description: Member identifier; build the author URN as urn:li:person:{sub}

locale.description: Member locale. Documented as text (sample: en-US); an object {country, language} is also accepted so a response in that form still validates

commentary.description: Post text. LinkedIn's little-text format reserves characters such as ( ) [ ] { } < > @ | ~ _ * which must be escaped with a backslash.
